title: Flash SegaSaturn Vol. 25
native_title: フラッシュ・セガサターン Ｖｏｌ．２５
overview:
Flash Sega Saturn Vol. 25 is a Japanese promotional disc from Sega's Flash Sega Saturn series, which presents Saturn games through trial versions and video footage.

This volume includes a self-running demo of Burning Rangers, showing the game's opening animation along with in-engine play of Shou in the first section of Mission 3 and Tillis taking on the Mission 1 boss.
